tones.name: Nylon Classical
tones.description: Warm nylon strings with a rounded top and a soft room.

tones.name: Steel Fingerpicked
tones.description: Fingertips on steel, close and detailed, with only a hint of room.

tones.name: Warm Jazz
tones.description: Neck humbucker with the highs rolled off: round, dark and smooth.

tones.name: Clean Single Coil
tones.description: Bright single-coil bridge with light compression and a little air.

tones.name: Muted Overdriven Guitar
tones.description: Palm-muted strings into a light overdrive: a tight, dry chug.

tones.name: Classic Rock Rhythm
tones.description: A pedal into a cranked amp: thick, even and ready for chords.

tones.name: Modern Metal Rhythm
tones.description: High gain with the mud cut out and the attack left sharp.

tones.name: 80s Lead
tones.description: Smooth lead with a long, even sustain.

tones.name: Round Acoustic
tones.description: An acoustic bass: woody, round and soft at the attack.

tones.name: Clean Finger
tones.description: Fingerstyle bass: even lows, a clear attack and no boom.

tones.name: Pick
tones.description: A pick on the strings: harder attack and a brighter top.

tones.name: Smooth Fretless
tones.description: Fretless glide: a soft attack and a singing sustain.

tones.name: Slap
tones.description: Snappy slap: compressed lows and a bright, popping top.

tones.name: Bright Slap
tones.description: A brighter slap with more pop and a lighter low end.

tones.name: Driven
tones.description: A bass pushed into a warm overdrive, still holding its low end.

tones.name: Deep Round
tones.description: A deep, round bass with the top rolled off.
